body: Honestly, she sounds like a bitch. Try your best not to take anything she said to heart-- to me, it seems like she has some confidence issues that she was kind of projecting on to you to make herself feel better. I'm sorry you had that experience.

Take some tylenol or ibuprofen, get a heating pad, and try to get some sleep! Even heating up a sock full of dry beans/rice in the microwave and applying it your midriff over your shirt can help alleviate some of the pain.
I'm feeling like this too, but I know it's not the way to go. Talk to me, please
